anya: heads up — after the kernel switch deploy we saw a big drop in prefix hit-rate for deploy-time primers :warning:
anya: initial alert showed prewarm hit-rate went from ~72% -> ~18% on the 16xx GPU pool
anya: snippet from the primer logs (we're seeding with prefix hashes):
```
seeded_keys=12000
matched_keys=2160
hit_rate=0.18
sample_key=sha256:8f3a...c9b7
```
kevin: do we have an example of a key mismatch? could be tokenizer normalization change from PR #3421 — that changed whitespace normalization for emojis
rafael: profiling confirms a divergence: old prefix serializer produced `pfx:v1:<norm>` vs new kernel path produces `pfx:v1:<norm_trimmed>` (we trim trailing spaces for batching perf)
ops-bot: [alert] primer-hit-rate < 25% on pool-16xx for 10m
chen: if keys are canonicalized differently we should fallback: map old_key -> new_key on lookup or emit both during seed phase :thinking_face:
anya: another wrinkle: autoscaler surge changed batch shapes (seq_len distribution) which triggered our new KV key path that includes a seq_len bucket — primers didn't include that bucket, so misses ballooned
kevin: proposed quick run: regenerate primers with both key variants (legacy + seq-bucketed) and push as a short-lived job. command: `./tools/seed_primer --range=00:00-02:00 --dual-key-mode`
rafael: ran a dry run locally; dual-key seeding increases primed entries ~1.9x but hit-rate jumps back to ~68%. logs:
```
primed=22000
matched=14960
hit_rate=0.68
cost_estimate_monthly=+$1.7k
```
anya: cost ok for immediate mitigation, but we need a longer fix: either stable key contract or a compat shim in runtime lookup
chen: +1 on compat shim. plan: (1) short dual-key seed for 24h, (2) add lookup shim that tries normalized and trimmed keys, (3) remove dual seeds after 72h of stable metrics :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll open rollout PR to add shim with a feature flag and small canary window (10% traffic)
anya: can we get eng-sre to schedule a canary during low-traffic window? pref midnight UTC
ops-bot: scheduled job: `canary-seed-dualkeys-351234` set for 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z — owner @kevin
rafael: also adding a quick eval to Console to track per-prefix-key hit-rate and per-kernel variant so we can detect future contract changes automatically
chen: filing a postmortem ticket and adding tokenizer PR to the checklist for kernel/serve changes
anya: thanks — let's keep messages in this thread for updates and paste perf graphs once canary runs.
